digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 14 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
repos.description: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matter
repos.summary_zh: 开源自主 AI Agent 框架，让任何人都能搭建并运行自动化任务，无需深度编程

repos.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

repos.name: FlowiseAI/Flowise
repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: 拖拽式搭建 AI 智能体的低代码平台，让复杂工作流可视化编排并一键部署

repos.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library

repos.description: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
